title: Gus and the Biggest Present
synopsis: Gus wants an enormous gift for Jack, but finds a better-sized surprise: Mr. Lee and Ms. Pam are making a small four-wheeled wagon for Jack's science notebook.
continuity_state: Before: The birthday picnic is scheduled. Jack is still nearly five; no gift has been revealed. Ms. Pam's garage and Mr. Lee's carpenter workshop relationships are established. After: Gus supplies a large cardboard box and a long blue ribbon. Mr. Lee and Ms. Pam continue making a small red wooden pull wagon at the garage. The gift remains a surprise; Gus draws five candles on its tag.
